purpose: Physically meaningful response extrapolation audit of already-frozen public-data predictors
readouts: Six visible spins in one column; rotate a seeded permutation of all eligible columns to cover all eight eligible columns
field_sign: Seeded independent global sign per nonzero-field case
neighbor_field: All perturbed sites lie in one adjacent column
remote_field: All perturbed sites lie in one column at distance at least four from the readout
freeze_policy: Save and hash the full query grid before opening the material parameters or evaluating any stress predictions
refitting: None; frozen fitted parameter files and original empirical recipe are reused without optimization
empirical_nonlocal_extension: The original recipe is unchanged for zero/readout-local fields. For nonlocal fields only, tilt training counts by exp(beta_query * sum u_i s_i), normalized to mean weight one, add the original 0.5 pseudocount, then apply the original affine log-probability bridge. This preregistered no-fit importance-reweighting extension is reported separately from original-recipe coverage.
diagnostics: field-induced response magnitude and response error
per_query_kl_notice: KL > 0.02 on one case is a diagnostic, not the original aggregate pass rule
uncertainty_policy: Model disagreement and poor importance support can suggest extrapolation sensitivity; no claim of irreducible finite-data uncertainty without a separate uncertainty analysis
prohibitions: no live task, data, target, evaluator, or status changes
